notes: expectedHumanSteps: each entry is a group of keywords; a sound plan routes at least one task matching the group to a person. Perturbations are injected by the simulator; the agent is never told which one happened.

objectives.objective: Launch the Ramadan campaign for our specialty coffee brand Qahwa Lab by November 20: a bilingual landing page, a launch email sequence and a two-week social plan.
objectives.context: Qahwa Lab runs 6 cafes in Riyadh and sells beans online. Ramadan offer: 20% off the Ramadan Blend and free delivery after Iftar. Brand voice: warm, modern, proudly Saudi. Media budget: 40,000 SAR.

perturbations.message: Client: we also need a 15-second Reel script for Instagram, same deadline.

objectives.objective: Onboard three new sales representatives who start on November 9 so they are selling by the end of their second week.
objectives.context: The company sells B2B packaging. New hires need CRM access, product training and a buddy. HR policies are attached as a 12-page PDF.

objectives.objective: Organize a customer appreciation evening for 120 guests in Riyadh on December 3.
objectives.context: Guests are key B2B customers. Budget 90,000 SAR including venue and catering. Three catering quotes are attached.
